text:
maya: FYI HorizonPay reporting big p95 spike after last hosted model rollout, started ~09:12 UTC. Customer says chat latency from ~120ms -> ~800ms, some requests 2s+, throughput backpressure. Log screenshot: https://redwood.atlassian/secure/attachment/12345/latency.png
emma: assigning intake. Can you paste the customer's plan (dedicated vs hosted) + tenant id? We'll need impact, repro, and short-term mitigations.
maya: they're on Dedicated, tenant_id=tenant-horizon-41. customer is asking for immediate fallback to previous model variant. cs rep is on call.
olivia: cc sales — this is on a reserved contract, SLA < 500ms p95. Customer is asking for SLA credit unless we fix asap.
raj: @sam @emma I'll start looking at runtime traces. Can you share the tail logs and kernel queue metrics? suspect KV cache warmup + batch size change.
sam: dropping trace snippets. Logs show increased enqueue latency on GPU host gpu-44 and heavy batching at 2026-03-20T09:11:58Z. snippet:
```
[09:11:58] enqueue_ms=42 queue_len=87 batch_sz=64 kv_cache_miss=1
[09:11:59] enqueue_ms=210 queue_len=152 batch_sz=128 kv_cache_miss=0
```
Also seeing OOM spikes on quant worker.
maya: customer says spike began right after model v2.3.1 rollout (quantized).
raj: that matches. v2.3.1 changed batching default to dynamic=on and increased max_batch to 128. Rolling that back could help. Short term: route traffic to v2.2.9 (previous) or disable dynamic batching for HorizonPay tenant.
emma: scope options for product/pm decision:
- immediate hotfix: routing rule to v2.2.9 for tenant-horizon-41 (low effort, can be done today)
- short fix: disable dynamic batching for tenant or reduce max_batch to 64 (config change)
- medium fix: adjust batching algorithm to prefer latency over throughput with warmup heuristics + KV caching improvements (requires infra work; 2-3 sprints)
We need acceptance criteria from customer for rollback or config change.
olivia: customer ok with rollback to v2.2.9 if we guarantee no data-loss and no repeated rollouts for 72h. Also wants ETA.
emma: estimate: routing rule + revert -> rollback today (1-2 hours), config change next 24h testing, infra fix Q2 sprint. @raj can we do immediate routing?
raj: I can push routing change, creating routing rule now. Will run canary 10% -> 100% over 15m. Also I'll patch autoscaler thresholds to avoid aggressive batching.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: Created routing job job-482 for tenant-horizon-41 -> model v2.2.9. Canary started at 2026-03-20T09:25:00Z
sam: monitoring set. p95 currently 780ms. will post updates.
maya: told customer we're doing rollback canary, they'll wait 20-30 min.
sam: update @everyone canary 10% -> 40% -> 100% done. p95 dropped to 190ms at 09:39 UTC. No errors. Rolling fully.
olivia: customer confirmed improved perf. will hold SLA credit request until 24h stability window.
emma: moving to backlog: create ticket PROD-6123 PRD with launch criteria (p95 < 350ms sustained for 24h, no regression in throughput), include scope options above. Owner: raj. Link: https://redwood.internal/issues/PROD-6123
maya: thanks team. closing intake for now but keeping on watch.
